attestations.text: LO Ping-chang 駱秉章 (T. 籲門, H. 儒齋, original ming 俊), Apr. 28, 1793–1867, Dec. 12, was a native of Hua-hsien, Kwangtung. After devoting his early life to study, he obtained in 1832 the chin-shih degree, and in the following year became a compiler of the Hanlin Academy.
